Baldur's Gate 2 is dramatically better in terms of gameplay and story than BG 1 (not to the least because you get to play higher-level characters). That being said, you will miss out on several critical parts in the story if you pass up on BG1 (most notably when it comes to an old enemy you can recruit in BG 2's expansion pack, Throne of Bhaal. BG1 also can be considerably harder than BG2 because crowd control spells often can result in a nigh-instant death for your party if you get an unlucky roll.

As for the difference between the regular and the Enhanced version: The Enhanced versions look nicer, unsurprisingly, and have fixed many of the bugs that plagued BG1 and 2. They also add new class kits (essentially specializations for classes), which can be pretty OP because the original game was never built around them. Finally, the enhanced editions add new characters to the game. It should be noted that these often are rather out of touch with the original game . In particular, I have a nasty memory of the new Half-Orc character Dorn Il-Khan suddenly turning flamboyantly homosexual because I was to nice to him during a BG2 run.
